description: Cognitive tag definitions for the Story Explorer reading comprehension assessment.

question_type_mapping.literal: Questions about explicit story details (who, what, where, when)
question_type_mapping.inferential: Questions requiring reasoning beyond stated text (why, how, theme)
question_type_mapping.vocabulary: Questions about word meaning in context

tags.description: Your child recalls and identifies stated facts from the text accurately.
Your child draws valid conclusions and inferences beyond the literal text.
Your child is developing good inference skills. Practice with 'why' and 'how' questions will help them go further.
Your child understands literal content but is still developing the ability to infer meaning. Practice with 'why' and 'how' questions will help.
Your child determines word meanings from surrounding context effectively.
Your child is still developing the ability to work out word meanings from context. Talking about new words while reading will help.
Your child demonstrates strong understanding of audio-narrated stories.
